subject: People priorities Q1 — engagement follow-ups & at-risk list
messages:
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 11 Feb 2025 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: People priorities Q1 — engagement follow-ups & at-risk list

Team —

Thanks to everyone who took the time to review the Q1 engagement snapshot I shared last week. I pulled a short list of folks flagged as higher attrition risk (see attached q1_engagement_atrisk.csv) and a simple manager action template for 1:1s (manager_action_template.docx). A few high-level asks: 

- Managers: please schedule a focused 30-min check-in with each person on the at-risk list in the next 7 business days. Use the template for consistency.
- Monica: can you pull up whether any of these folks have pending compensation changes or open hiring/replacement conversations?
- Rishi / Markus: I want you both to review your org-level patterns (escalation points, workload spikes) and propose one operational fix each by Friday.

I know this is sensitive — please keep the thread restricted. I copied the Drive folder with supporting notes here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2b3Cexample. If you want an external read (communication coaching) I’ve tentatively looped in Amy from Palo Verde Consulting on standby; she’s only cc'd on the follow-up where we might ask for wording help.

Short answers are fine. We’ll reconvene briefly in the leadership sync next Monday for status.

Thanks,
Laura
Laura Bennett
VP, Customer Reliability & Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Feb 2025 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: People priorities Q1 — engagement follow-ups & at-risk list

Laura — thanks for the summary and the attachments. I reviewed the CSV and will block time for the four folks from my org this week (Thu/Fri). Preliminary observations: two of them have been carrying extended on-call rotations and one is working on a long-running, high-ambiguity project with limited staffing.

Action items from me:
- Schedule 30-min check-ins and send calendar invites today.
- Propose a temporary on-call rotation adjustment + assign a short-term backup to reduce load.
- Share suggested 1:1 notes in the Drive folder by Friday.

I'll update the thread with confirmations.

— Markus
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Feb 2025 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: People priorities Q1 — engagement follow-ups & at-risk list

Quick update from People Ops: I cross-referenced the at-risk list with pending HR items. Notes: 

- Two individuals have upcoming performance-review conversations in March (no compensation changes yet).
- One has an active internal transfer request that was put on hold (I will re-open the discussion with the hiring manager if needed).
- No open disciplinary actions or formal warnings.

I can provide managers with a short script and coaching pointers. Markus / Laura — I’ll upload the script to the Drive folder (manager_1on1_script_v1.docx) and can join any 1:1s if a manager wants live support.

Monica
Senior Manager, People Operations
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Amy Liu <amy@pvc-consulting.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2025 12:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: People priorities Q1 — engagement follow-ups & at-risk list

Adding a small update from my side: I ran a quick look at recent bug-queue churn and PR review latency for the folks on the list — latency is up ~30% for two of them, which aligns with Markus's on-call note.

Couple of asks:
- Monica: can you confirm whether we can reassign one open project ticket to free up a week of focus for the most affected engineer?
- Laura / Markus: is it okay to offer a one-time discretionary recognition (small bonus / spot grant) for the person who took on extra on-call duties for the last six weeks? If yes, Monica can advise the approval path.

I cc'd Amy (external consultant) because we might want a few phrasing suggestions for the 1:1s — Amy, if you can draft two short scripts (one for retention-forward conversation and one for workload-realignment) by Monday that would be helpful.

Thanks,
Dev
Engineering Manager
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Amy Liu <amy@pvc-consulting.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Feb 2025 20:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: People priorities Q1 — engagement follow-ups & at-risk list

All — appreciate the quick turn. Short decisions: 

- Monica: please proceed with the manager coaching script upload and advise the discretionary recognition path. If approval is straightforward, we can do a single spot grant (under 1k) via Monica’s approval route.
- Markus: implement the temporary on-call rotation adjustment and document the backup assignment.
- Dev: please reassign one project ticket; coordinate with the affected engineer and confirm in the Drive notes.
- Amy: please share the two short scripts by EOD Monday; keep tone coaching-forward and non-inflationary (focus on empathy + concrete follow-up).

I'll join any 1:1s if managers ask for presence. Thanks for moving quickly on this.

Laura
VP, Customer Reliability & Operations
